question: The mean and variance of 5 observations are 4 and 5.2 respectively. If three of the observations are 1, 2, 6, find the other two observations
explanation:
Sum of all 5 observations = 5 × 4 = 20

Sum of known three = 1+2+6 = 9

Sum of remaining two = 20-9 = 11

Since variance = (sum of xi²)/5 - 16 = 5.2, sum of xi² = 5(21.2) = 106

Sum of squares of known three = 1+4+36 = 41

Sum of squares of remaining two = 106-41 = 65

Let the two numbers be a and b: a+b=11, a²+b²=65

(a+b)² = 121 = 65+2ab, so 2ab=56, ab=28

Solving t²-11t+28=0 gives t=4 or t=7
